sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
Standing by at HQ to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery, currently sitting at 18%.
Leaving standby with the Ops Phone at 27%; commencing patrols, returning later to continue recharging.
Commencing Alpha Route; patrolling along Queen Street, waking street vagrants sleeping in front of stores and ensuring no issues are visible. Welfare check at Starbucks, all clear.
Welfare check at Dunkin Donuts, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly scoped for any issues, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street; area thoroughly scoped for any visible problems, all clear.

Welfare check along McDonald's Britomart, all clear.

Welfare check along Woolworths Metro, all clear.

Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Arrived at Federal Square; welfare checks commenced around the Cathedral church, all clear.

Welfare check completed along Little Albert's Coffee, The People's Barista, Sergeant Coffee, Formery and Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear. Continuing patrols along Albert Street.

Welfare check completed along City Convenience Store and the bakery store, all clear.

Arrived at the check-in at the top of Victoria Street; welfare check along 77 Convenience Store and area scoped for any issues, all clear. Standing by to ensure a strong security presence while awaiting response calls.
Stopped and spoke with JD Convenience Store, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street; welfare checks on the static guards and a quick stop for a drink. No issues raised.
Arrived at Elliott Street; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area, all clear. Standing by for a visible presence.
Continuing patrols and making our presence visible along Queen Street, patrolling down towards TK Square and conducting welfare checks along all stores.
Welfare checks commenced along Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Imperial Lane; floor checks completed, all clear. Heading back to HQ due to the Ops Phone battery running low.
Arrived at HQ; took the timesheet to Level 7 and standing by to recharge the Ops Phone while awaiting further response calls.
Arrived at Elliott Street; taking our morning interval break.
Response call from Roma Blooms reporting two street vagrants smoking what smelled like drug substances.
Arrived at the location; spoke with the two individuals, who agreed to move along after a short rest.
Both individuals have now moved along; no further issues present. Ending Delta Route.
Commencing Echo Route, patrolling down Albert Street ensuring a strong security presence. Welfare check at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.

Welfare check at Woolworths Metro and Aotea Gifts, all clear.
Welfare check along OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay check-in; full walkthrough completed, ensuring no issues are present, all clear. Standing by to show presence while awaiting response calls.
Arrived at the Kiwibank check-in; welfare checks completed on all stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at the check-in at the bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks commenced on all stores within the area, all clear. En route to HQ to recharge the Ops Phone, battery sitting at 10%.
Arrived at the Wilson Carpark check-in, all clear. Welfare checks conducted on all stores within the area, all clear.
Commencing welfare checks along High Street stores and businesses, all clear.
Arrived at HQ; standing by to recharge the Ops Phone and taking lunch break.
Lunch break completed; continuing to stand by recharging the Ops Phone and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Morning shift completed; changeover to the Afternoon Shift.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 2 x Radios, 2 x Bodycams, 1 x Swipe Key.
Debrief with the Morning Shift regarding the morning status of the CBD completed. Commencing patrols and routes.
Attending to a message from Nathan on the community page regarding a male individual in front of Dunkin' Donuts bothering customers for money.
Arrived at the response location; the individual was no longer present. Keeping a lookout for him using the picture provided in the community thread.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence before moving along.
Standing by in front of Lovisa to maintain a visible presence; commencing Alpha Route from Lovisa.
Slow patrols and welfare checks due to heavy foot traffic during trading hours; all clear:
Standing by at the intersection of Wyndham Street and Queen Street to maintain a visible security presence while remaining vigilant.
Welfare checks conducted at businesses along Vulcan Lane, all clear:
Patrolling down Queen Street towards Britomart Square.
Welfare checks conducted at BNZ Place, the BNZ Building entrance on Shortland Street, Partridge Jewellery and Pocket Park on Jean Batten Avenue. All clear.
Standing by in front of Cartier to maintain a visible security presence.
Welfare checks conducted at Cookes, Fable, Luxury Karaoke, Quest, Western Union Money Exchange and Q Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare check and building sweep around Imperial Lane to ensure no unauthorised individuals were present. All clear.
Standing by on Lower Queen Street to maintain a visible security presence.
Welfare check conducted at Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at the Commercial Bay checkpoint; conducted a full sweep around the area to ensure no issues.
Welfare checks conducted at McDonald's Britomart, Starbucks and Kowhai Cafe. All clear.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence due to heavy foot traffic towards the train station.
Welfare checks conducted along Customs Street East, all clear:
Mistry Shoe Repair and Key Cutting
Welfare check and walkthrough conducted along Fort Lane.

Standing by at the corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane. Proceeding towards the next checkpoint at Aotea Square via High Street and Lorne Street, remaining close to Queen Street rather than Albert Street due to the higher frequency of calls in this area at this time of day.
Welfare checks conducted along Lower High Street, all clear:
Standing by at Chancery Square and Freyberg Square.
Welfare checks conducted around Chancery Square, all clear:
Welfare check conducted at the Chancery Square car park. All clear.
Heading back to HQ to charge the Ops Phone, which was at 5% battery.
Arrived back at HQ to charge the Ops Phone; percentage shown on camera. Standing by while charging before resuming patrol routes.
Response call from Auckland Council regarding a female individual who allegedly stole from Kece11 at Chancery Square; the individual was reportedly wearing bunny-ear props. (Photo on file.)
Attended the response call location but did not encounter the female individual.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence.
Arrived back at HQ to continue charging the Ops Phone.
Attending a response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding individuals loitering in front of the store; assistance requested to move them along.
Ops Phone battery at 13% and charging slowly; the battery may be deteriorating. Power banks or a replacement phone may be required.
Arrived at the response location; the individual had already left. Store staff did not have access to CCTV footage and the manager was not on site.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence before returning to charge the Ops Phone, which was at 12% battery.
Standing by at the Commercial Bay stairs, monitoring the area for potential issues and watching in case the male individual returned to McDonald's Britomart so security could intervene if necessary.
Continuing to stand by at Commercial Bay to maintain a visible security presence (19:08–19:19).
Leaving the standby position and commencing welfare checks along Albert Street towards HQ.
Welfare checks conducted at Albert Mart Convenience Store, Discount Dairy and Vape Shop, and Ace Karaoke. All clear.
Observed a male individual previously involved in damaging property at Radisson RED several weeks earlier making his way towards Commercial Bay.
Followed the individual and issued a verbal trespass warning. The individual complied and confirmed on camera that he would not return.
Returning to patrol routes. Ops Phone battery at 10%.
Welfare checks conducted at Good To Go Supermarket, Barclay's Suites and Cassia. All clear.
Welfare checks conducted at Studio 7, Mobile Doctor, Tattoo Shop and Skymart Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at the checkpoint at the top of Victoria Street and Federal Street. All clear.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence before moving along. Ops Phone battery at 9%.
Leaving the standby position and heading down towards Queen Street.
Welfare checks conducted at Lord Nelson's Steak House and Woolworths Victoria Street West, which was closing.
Welfare checks conducted at Tandoor, Domino's Pizza, the Wilson Carpark food stalls, Pizza Club, Celine Mediterranean Cuisine and Mali Thai. All clear.
Arrived at the checkpoint at the corner of Darby Street and Queen Street. All clear.
Standing by to maintain a visible security presence before returning to HQ to conduct floor checks.
Arrived at HQ to conduct floor checks.
Mandatory building sweep completed. The sweep could not be conducted earlier due to the low battery level of the Ops Phone and attendance at response calls.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone, battery at 6%; percentage shown on camera (20:35–21:30).
Ops Phone battery returned to a healthy percentage. Resuming patrol routes around the middle section of Queen Street.
Standing by near Avachi. Welfare checks conducted, all clear:
Standing by in the middle section of Queen Street to maintain a visible security presence (21:41–21:45).
Welfare check conducted at Elliott Stables; standing by on Elliott Street.
Welfare check conducted at Te Waihorotiu train station. All clear.
Welfare check conducted through Skyworld Entertainment. All clear.
Slowly heading towards HQ while remaining vigilant and awaiting changeover to the Night Shift.
Standing by at the corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne Street. All clear.
Standing by near the Lorne Street fountain area.
Standing by at Timezone before heading back to HQ.
Slowly heading back to HQ while maintaining a visible security presence.
Arrived back at HQ, awaiting changeover to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycams, 2 x Radios.
Debrief with the Afternoon Shift before gearing up and commencing patrols; debrief completed at 22:45.
Charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols.
Welfare checks conducted at Avachi, McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store. All clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Aotea Square and commenced a security sweep of the area.
Continuing patrols and monitoring at Aotea Square (00:00–00:15).
Completed a full sweep of Aotea Square, including welfare checks at the front and rear of Q Theatre and the surrounding area. No issues identified. Proceeding to patrol Lorne Street.
Welfare check conducted along Rutland Street. All clear, no issues reported.
Completed patrol of the upper section of Lorne Street. All clear.
Welfare check conducted at the Lorne Street staircase near the mural centre. All clear, no issues reported.
Completed welfare checks and patrols along the entire length of Lorne Street. All clear.
Completed a full sweep of Victoria Street, including welfare checks at Skymart and 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Completed a full sweep of Federal Street, all clear. Arrived at Federal Square and commenced a security sweep of the area.
Continuing patrols and monitoring at Federal Square.
Completed a full sweep of Federal Square, including welfare checks at the Cathedral and Liston House. All clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at Ace Karaoke; standing by to maintain a visible security presence (01:25–01:45).
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual harassing staff members and customers. Proceeding to the location.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; the male individual was still outside the premises. Security politely requested that he move along, but he refused and requested Police attendance. Remained on site awaiting Police due to the individual's aggressive behaviour towards staff and customers.
Police arrived at the location and moved the individual on from the premises. Security remained on standby to assist Police.
Stood down from Police assistance following the incident at McDonald's Queen Street; area confirmed clear. Proceeding towards HQ to retrieve equipment.
Ops Phone battery reported at a low percentage.
Charging the Ops Phone at HQ (03:30–04:15).
Gearing up and preparing to resume patrols; Ops Phone battery confirmed at a satisfactory level.
Completed a full sweep of Victoria Street. All clear. Proceeding to patrol Federal Street.
Completed a full sweep of Federal Street. Arrived at Federal Square and commenced a security sweep of the area.
Completed a full sweep of Federal Square, including welfare checks at the Cathedral and Liston House. No unauthorised individuals found sheltering in the area. Proceeding down Wyndham Street.
Completed patrol of Wyndham Street. All clear, no issues reported. Proceeding down Queen Street.
Completed a full sweep of Queen Street. All clear, no issues reported. Arrived at Britomart and commenced a security sweep of the area.
Continuing patrols and monitoring at Britomart.
Completed a full sweep of Britomart, including a welfare check at McDonald's. All clear. Returning to HQ to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ and commenced a 30-minute break (05:37–06:00).
Response call from the cafe at 16 Kingston Street regarding a male individual harassing staff members inside the premises. Proceeding to the location.

Arrived at the response location; the male individual had already left the premises. Conducted a welfare check on staff members, who confirmed they were fine. No further issues reported. Returning to HQ.
Arrived at HQ; standing by awaiting guard handover.
Incident reference recorded regarding the earlier response at McDonald's Queen Street involving the male individual harassing customers.
Night shift concluded; handover to the Morning Shift completed.
